''See also: [[Alchemist's Guild Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|The Alchemist's [[Guild]], also known as the [[Guild]] of [[Alchemists]] or [[Kanatalia]], is one of the ten influential [[Imperial Guilds]] that serve as pillars of the [[Aurelian Empire]]. Recognized as the wealthiest and most well-connected of these organizations, the [[Guild]] plays a vital support role that allows other [[Guilds]] to function. Their members are often identified by their distinctive uniforms, which include stained leather aprons and large glass goggles. While some Alchemists{{!}}alchemists focus on traditional research or medical applications, the [[Guild]] is also known for its capacity to produce dangerous substances, such as exotic poisons, paralytics, and hallucinogens. [[The Guild]] maintains various properties across The Empire{{!}}the Empire, including chapter houses and specialized workshops that can range from simple warehouses to elaborate structures. Their operations include conducting experiments on high-level [[Imperial]] prisoners to alter their physical and mental states, as well as training professionals in the discipline. [[The Guild]]'s influence extends to the creation of specialized equipment, such as alchemical stoves and modified weaponry. Despite their reputation for being against peace, they are a highly organized entity with a significant private security presence. [[The Guild]] is led by a Head who is noted for being extremely wealthy, highly paranoid, and capable of utilizing powerful stimulants. The organization's activities are deeply intertwined with The Empire{{!}}the Empire's power structures, occasionally engaging in secret negotiations or receiving direct assignments from the Emperor.}}

== Of Shadow and Sea ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Based in [[Kanatalia]], the Alchemist's [[Guild]] maintains significant influence through various professional and political connections. The organization manages formal contracts with individuals such as Ulrich Fletcher{{!}}Fletcher and maintains an association with [[Kanatalia]] itself. Its Authority{{!}}authority is substantial enough to enforce its power over figures like [[Meia]]. Furthermore, the [[Guild]] serves a high-level political function by carrying out specific assignments issued by the Emperor.}}

<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">5</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|Ulrich Fletcher{{!}}Fletcher has Alchemist's Guild{{!}}Alchemist’s Guild contracts.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c2">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 2</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Kanatalia]] is associated with the Alchemist's Guild{{!}}Alchemist’s Guild.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c8">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 8</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|[[Meia]] is enforced by the power of the Alchemist's Guild{{!}}Alchemist’s Guild.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c11">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 11</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Alchemist's Guild{{!}}Guild of Alchemists is located in [[Kanatalia]].<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c16">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 16</ref>}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea|The Alchemist's Guild{{!}}Guild of Alchemists carries out assignments from the Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-01-of-shadow-and-sea-c24">''Of Shadow and Sea'', chapter 24</ref>}}</li>
</ul></div>
